name: virgil-desk
description: Virgil Desk — browser allocation desk for you and agents

scripts.build: npm run build -w @virgil-desk/protocol && npm run build -w @virgil-desk/extension
scripts.test: npm run test -w @virgil-desk/protocol && npm run test -w @virgil-desk/extension
scripts.test:playwright: npm run build -w @virgil-desk/extension && pip install -e ./packages/host[dev] -q && cd packages/e2e/playwright && npm install && npx playwright install chromium && (command -v xvfb-run >/dev/null && xvfb-run -a npm test || npm test)
scripts.test:all: npm run test && npm run test:host && npm run test:e2e && npm run test:playwright
